name: linkwarden
title: linkwarden
author: yunix-intel
description:
龙芯版说明

架构：linux/loong64（仅龙芯 3A5000/3A6000）

与上游差异：Next 15 在 x86 构建；Prisma 7 WASM + adapter-pg；自写 99 个 SQL 迁移器；bcryptjs 替代 bcrypt。

缺失功能：无 Meilisearch 时仅 SQL contains（自建 Meili 已验证）；默认无浏览器；monolith 需挂载；AI 需外部 provider；导入已验证；OAuth 未验证。

额外依赖：需 PostgreSQL；PLAYWRIGHT_WS_URL 接 LBrowser sidecar；/data/data；3000；UID 1118。

镜像说明：2.16.3；Next 15 x86 构建；Prisma 7 WASM + adapter-pg + 自写迁移器；bcryptjs；不装 sharp；`/data`；3000；UID 1118；搜索回退 SQL contains；不内置浏览器；OAuth 未验证；邮件流需模板+BASE_URL
description_en:
LoongArch notes

Architecture: linux/loong64 only

Differences: Next 15 is built on x86; Prisma 7 uses the WASM compiler with adapter-pg; a custom runner applies the 99 SQL migrations; bcryptjs replaces bcrypt.

Missing features: Search falls back to SQL contains without Meilisearch (self-hosted Meili is verified); no browser by default; monolith needs a mount; AI needs an external provider; import is verified; OAuth is unverified.

Extra dependencies: Requires PostgreSQL; point PLAYWRIGHT_WS_URL at an LBrowser sidecar; /data/data; port 3000; UID 1118.

Image notes: 2.16.3；Next 15 x86 构建；Prisma 7 WASM + adapter-pg + 自写迁移器；bcryptjs；不装 sharp；`/data`；3000；UID 1118；搜索回退 SQL contains；不内置浏览器；OAuth 未验证；邮件流需模板+BASE_URL

notes: PostgreSQL sidecar 必需；public 变体使用 LBrowser sidecar，private 变体内置浏览器；/data/data 持久化。
安装器会先启动 sidecar：linkwarden-pg, linkwarden-lbrowser。
未在 OpenWrt/iStoreOS 真机上执行安装回归；仅做 ipk 结构与 JSON schema 静态校验。
